text: 从“一脑多机”到万架齐飞：中国制造亮出系统级能力｜70载广交会 前三季度我国装备制造业贡献近九成出口增量，工业母机、机器人与精密制造构筑起外贸不可替代的技术壁垒。
text_en: From 'one brain, multiple machines' to ten thousand aircraft flying together: Made in China demonstrates system-level capability | 70 years of the Canton Fair. In the first three quarters, China's equipment manufacturing industry contributed nearly 90% of export growth, with industrial machine tools, robots and precision manufacturing building an irreplaceable technical barrier for foreign trade.
